title: Moon Phase vs Catch Success
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch moon_phase=*
| stats count as catches, avg(weight_kg) as avg_weight by moon_phase
| sort - catches
description: Compares catch success across logged moon phases without pretending folklore is automatically true.
value: If there is a pattern for your waters and species, this is how to earn it rather than assume it.
implementation: Include moon-phase context on catch logs; summarize count and average weight by phase.
visualization: Bar chart of catches by moon phase with average weight overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It spots whether your catch results really seem to change with the moon phase or only feel that way.
